name: Felt Maps
what: Web maps: layers from data at a URL, choropleths, map-linked charts and filters, basemap and view settings, designed print pages, and image, PDF or SVG export. Access to the map tools depends on the workspace plan.
install: Attach the Felt Maps connector in the host's connector settings, then sign in with the user's Felt account. The Felt workspace plan must include MCP access; a workspace admin changes the plan in workspace settings.
firstCall: none as one init call; call the guidance tool for the job first: get_geocoding_guidance, get_print_item_guidance or get_sql_editing_guidance
evidenceNote: Written from tool schemas alone. The one data call made (get_print_item_guidance) was refused: the workspace plan did not include MCP access. No map tool ran and no guidance text was read, so every map function is untested. developer_docs was not called. Several tools that the descriptions name, including any create-map tool, were absent from the session.
